title: Assorted Wall Accessorie Swing Arm Double Towel Rail 12.5-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount, Waverly Place | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Allied Brass
description:
Add flexible towel storage to a bathroom with this wall mount swing arm double towel rail in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom. Two pivoting arms swivel independently for easy access, then fold in close to the wall to help save space.

Highlights:
- Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished look
- Solid brass construction
- Coordinates with the Waverly Place collection for cohesive transitional bathroom hardware

Specs:
- Category: Assorted Wall Accessories
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Material: Brass
- Dimensions: 12.5 in L x 7 in W x 7.1 in H
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Included items: Towel rail and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Finish availability: multiple designer finish options
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
